item.title: Manny Pacquiao’s Son Eman Bacosa Scores Five Knockdowns in Bohol
item.description: Eman Bacosa did not need the scorecards in Bohol, as five knockdowns rendered them unnecessary. On Saturday at the Bohol Cultural Center in Tagbilaran City, Bacosa dropped Indonesia’s Reynold Kundimang five times before forcing a fourth-round stoppage at 2:26.
